join.title: Download shared files
join.description: Paste the transfer code your sender gave you to connect.
join.invalidCode: That doesn’t look like a valid transfer code.

connecting.description: Establishing a secure peer-to-peer link. This usually takes a few seconds.

stage.idle: Verifying transfer code and fetching the file list…
stage.waiting: Connected — waiting for the file list…

download.title: {{files}} shared with you
download.description: Download them right here in your browser — no app or account needed.
download.inAppWarning: This browser can’t save downloads. Open the link in Safari or Chrome to receive your files.

errors.relayUnreachable: Cannot reach the AlterSend relay. Check your connection and try again.
errors.senderNotFound: Sender not found — make sure the sender is sharing.
errors.nothingShared: Connected, but the sender did not share anything.
errors.connectionFailed: Connection lost — the sender may have stopped sharing. Try again.

promo.title: Sent with AlterSend
promo.subtitle: Get the app to send files of your own

disconnected.title: The sender disconnected
disconnected.description: AlterSend transfers are peer-to-peer, so the connection needs both sides online. Ask the sender to reopen the transfer, then reconnect.
disconnected.summary_complete: All {{total}} files were downloaded before the link dropped.
disconnected.completeDescription: The sender went offline, but every file arrived — you’re all set.
disconnected.waitingTitle: Waiting for the sender to reconnect
disconnected.waitingBody: The connection dropped. Once they reopen the transfer, pick up where you left off.

sendBack.title: Want to send files back?
sendBack.description: Get the AlterSend app to send files of any size — end-to-end encrypted, no account needed.

tooLarge.title: Too big for the browser
tooLarge.description: Some transfers are better received in the app.
tooLarge.body: Open it in the AlterSend app to receive it — no account needed.
